principle.title: Principles of AI interpretation
principle.computed: Numbers, tables and graphs are computed by the server. The same records always give the same values.
principle.interpretation: Only the written interpretation is made by the AI, shown together with the provider and model that made it.
principle.onRequest: The AI is called only when you ask for it. A call uses your key and your usage limits, and the same input shows the stored result again.

providerNotice.title: About key storage and costs
providerNotice.storage: The key is stored encrypted on this server and used only for AI calls. You can revoke it at any time in the provider console.
providerNotice.billing: AI calls happen only when you request them, and the cost is billed to your provider account. Setting a spending limit in the provider console is recommended.

profile.title: Weakness profile
profile.loadError: Could not load the weakness profile
profile.emptyDescription: Play 7KEYS SP with the new client to collect traces; this page then shows the patterns you cannot hit and the density you cannot hold.
profile.intro: Computed from {plays} traced 7KEYS plays on {charts} charts ({notes} notes) over the last {days, number} days. No AI is called.
profile.windowNotes: SCRATCH AUTO plays {auto, number} (left out of density and scratch cells) · training chart plays {training, number} · old analyses waiting to be recomputed {stale, number}
profile.trainingClusterNote: Training chart plays count as one group even across charts. Playing many training charts adds only one chart to a sample, so training shows its effect in plays of regular charts.
profile.densityInsufficient: Not enough notes and charts per density bin to draw the density limit.
profile.densitySummary: Comfortable density {comfort} · EX limit {limitEx} · BP limit {limitBp}
profile.densitySeen: Highest density bin played {maxSeen} · peak 2 s density {peak} · baseline EX {baseline}
profile.noCeiling: Your EX has not dropped to the limit at the densities you played. Play denser charts to find the limit.
profile.sustained: EX of sustained minus burst sections at the same density {value}
profile.densityChartLabel: EX ratio by density. Comfortable density {comfort}, EX limit {limitEx}, BP limit {limitBp}, highest density played {maxSeen}.
profile.weaknessesEmpty: No weakness with enough evidence yet. As plays add up, weaknesses that pass the test appear here.
profile.comboHint: How much EX you lose when two patterns come together. Darker loses more; a thick border is a weakness with enough evidence. Empty cells are pairs without enough sample.
profile.bpRunsLine: Mean longest BAD/POOR run per chart {longest} · median notes to recover {recovery}
profile.gaugeLine: Gauge drops per play {drops} · mean density in drops {dropNps} NPS (overall {overallNps} NPS)

training.title: Make a training chart
training.fullTitle: Your training chart storage is full
training.fullDescription: Up to {limit, number} training charts are kept and none is deleted automatically. To make a new one, delete one you no longer use from the list below first.
training.optionNotice: This chart drills a lane or a hand. Turn off RANDOM-family options when you play it; an option moves the notes to other lanes, and the chart no longer trains the hand or lane it was made for.
training.limitRaced: The training chart limit was reached somewhere else first. Delete one and make it again. The AI call may already have been used.

guide.intro: A chart you make goes into your "Training" folder automatically, and the R-BMS client can download and play it right away. New charts arrive when the client fetches your folders (at start, at login, and on an F6 refresh).
guide.steps: How to get it: on the client's song select, open the "Training" folder in MY FOLDERS, find the dimmed row, and press GET CHART. You can also copy the download address and fetch it yourself.

list.title: My training charts
list.label: My training charts
list.emptyDescription: Pick a weakness and an intensity above to make your first one.

form.label: Make a training chart
form.description: Pick a weakness and the AI plans the sections; the server then lays the plan out as a one-minute 7KEYS chart. The AI is called once with your key, only when you press the button.
form.loadError: Could not load the weakness profile
form.linkedKeyMissing: The weakness in the link is not in your profile now, or no chart can be made for it, so another item was picked.

build.name: BUILD

push.name: PUSH
push.description: From near your comfortable density up to the density where your EX gives out.

over.name: OVER
over.description: From your comfortable density to 1.15 times the density where your EX gives out.

form.pending: The AI is planning the chart and the server is laying it out. This can take a few minutes, so keep this page open.

strip.hint: A segment's width is its length, its height is the notes per second the laid-out chart really has, and the dashed line is the target NPS. Colour shows the pattern kind.

beforeAfter.afterMissing: Not enough plays to meet the sample conditions yet
beforeAfter.hint: The value before is the weakness profile when the chart was made; the value since is measured again, with the same sample conditions, on the plays after it. With few plays the value swings a lot.

detail.title: Training chart
detail.notFoundDescription: It was deleted, or it is not a training chart of your account.
detail.loadError: Could not load the training chart
detail.playLevelNote: PLAYLEVEL is not a difficulty table level; it is the highest notes per second of any section, as an integer.
detail.getInGame: Get it in the client: the "Training" folder in MY FOLDERS, the dimmed row, then GET CHART. You can also copy the download address and fetch it yourself.
detail.correctionsTitle: Values the server changed in the AI's plan
detail.correctionsHint: When a value the AI chose is outside the allowed range or does not suit the weakness, the server fixes it and lists it here.
detail.trendHint: Plays run in order (the oldest on the left) and each section shows how its EX ratio moved. On a section that drills a lane or a hand, plays with a RANDOM-family option are drawn faint and left out of the line.
